items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Maybe it was Gilly Coggins… Yeah, maybe it was Gilly.

ctx.x: Kenny Clarke. And who was playing piano? I don’t remember who was playing piano at that time. Jimmy made some of the gigs up in Boston with the Symphony Sid All-Stars. It might have been Kenny Drew, not sure about the piano player. But that’s some more association with Miles that I had, and Kenny, Kenny Clarke. Maybe it was Gilly Coggins…
